senses.gloss: प्रघटा f. (-टा) The first principles of a science.

प्रघटाविद् m. (-विद्) A general reader, but not a profound one.
E. प्रघटा said to imply novelty, and विद् who knows.

प्रघण m. (-णः)
 1. A terrace before a house.
 2. A copper pot.
3. An iron crow or club.
 E. प्र before हन् to strike, aff. अप्,
and the radical letter changed; also प्रघाण प्रघन, and प्रघान ।

प्रघाण m. (-णः) A covered terrace or small portico before the
door of house.
 E. प्र before, हन् to strike, (with the feet,)
aff. अप्, and the radical vowel changed optionally; also प्रघण ।

प्रघन m. (-नं)
 1. A covered terrace before a house.
 2. A sort of bean,
(Phaseolus mungo.)
 E. प्र before, हन् to strike or hurt, aff. अप्.

प्रघान m. (-नः) A covered terrace before the door of a house,
a porch, a portico: see प्रघन, and प्रघण ।

प्रघस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Voracious.
 m. (-सः)
 1. Eating much.
 2. A
Daitya, a demon.
 E. प्र much, वस for अद् to eat, aff. अप् or अच् ।

प्रघात m. (-तः)
 1. Combat, battle.
 2. Killing.
 E. प्र violently, घात striking;
also प्राघात ।

प्राघात m. (-तः) War, battle.
 E. प्र before, हन् to kill, aff. घञ्, and the
vowel of the prefix optionally made long.
प्रघुण m. (-णः) A guest; It is another form of प्राघुण ।

प्राघुण m. (-णः) A guest, a visitor, one demanding hospitality.
 E. प्र and
आङ् before, घुण् to turn round, aff. क ।

प्राघुण(णि)क m. (-कः)
 1. A guest.
 E. प्रघुण स्वार्थें ठक् ।

प्रघूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
 1. Turning round or rolling violently.
2. Wandering, roaming.
 m. (-र्णः) A guest, a visitor.
 E. प्र
before, घूर्ण to turn round, aff. अच्ः Also प्राघूर्ण ।

प्रघोषक m. (-कः) Sound, noise.
 E. प्र much, घोष sound, aff. कन् ।

प्राघार m. (-रः) Dropping, oozing, trickling, aspersion, or pouring out
of any oily substance.
 E. प्र before, घॄ to sprinkle or drop,
aff. घञ् ।

प्राघूर्णिक m. (-कः) A guest.
 E. प्र before, घूर्ण going about, aff. ठक् ।
